page.overview:
Who is Ackmora?

Ackmora was a Mon Calamari male who served as a Jedi Master of the Jedi Order during the High Republic Era. He was stationed on Eiram with his Padawan Chalara Matanga.

Ackmora appeared in the 2024 Audible Original The High Republic: Seeds of Starlight, written by George Mann for the Star Wars: The High Republic multimedia project.
